scientific_claim_audit.positioning: SatQuery-AI accepts heterogeneous satellite imagery, validates compatibility, adapts supported inputs, and routes them to specialist models. Each specialist has a documented validated domain, and unsupported imagery is explicitly flagged rather than producing misleading predictions.

questions.Q1_can_accept_non_levir_imagery: YES — The system inspects and adapts diverse satellite imagery (TIFF, GeoTIFF, uint16, SAR, multispectral).
questions.Q2_can_safely_determine_cd_appropriatene: YES — The Change Detection Domain Gate evaluates sensor, resolution, overlap, and query domain before invoking the LEVIR-CD model.
questions.Q3_can_refuse_unsupported_without_halluc: YES — Refused imagery produces structured limitations and transparent explanations without fake change maps or fabricated percentages.
questions.Q4_can_judge_upload_arbitrary_and_always: NO — Arbitrary satellite imagery cannot be reliably analyzed by a single specialist. SatQuery-AI will refuse or flag imagery outside validated specialist domains rather than producing a misleading prediction.
